queries.query: I'm adding a TEME-to-GCRS conversion to our Rust astrodynamics library so I can compare SGP4 output against our numerical propagator. Walk me through what it actually needs and how to type it so I can't mix frames or time scales.

We're reworking our Epoch types to add GPS time without hand-writing a conversion for every pair of scales, and we keep getting UT1-vs-UTC and frame-mixing bugs. How should we structure the conversions and what should the types enforce?
One of our ephemerides is TEME from a TLE and the other is GCRS from the propagator. Are these the same frame, and how do I reconcile them before differencing the positions?
Can you review this GCRS-to-ITRS rotation I wrote and check I'm not missing a time-scale or EOP subtlety before I merge it?
Double-check how I'm transforming this orbit state covariance between the RTN frame and ECI — I rotated it but I'm not sure that's right.
I'm interpolating satellite positions between two ECEF samples a few minutes apart and the ground track comes out slightly wrong. What am I doing wrong?
My near-circular sun-synchronous orbit test throws NaNs when I convert the Cartesian state to classical Keplerian elements. How should I handle this?
Is feeding my UTC timestamp straight into the sidereal-time / Earth-rotation-angle formula correct, or am I introducing an error?
In my Three.js scene I'm rotating a 3D mesh around the Y axis and composing it with the camera quaternion, but the orientation comes out wrong. How do I compose these rotations correctly?
I need to convert a column of UTC datetimes to US/Pacific local time for a report, handling DST correctly, in pandas.
Parse this ISO 8601 timestamp string into a Unix epoch integer for my Go log formatter.
Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs cargo test and clippy on every PR to main.
How do I use PhantomData to make a typed wrapper around a u64 so I can't accidentally mix a UserId with an OrderId in my web backend?
Design a Postgres schema for storing time-series sensor readings with a timestamp column and efficient time-range queries.
Convert these GPS latitude/longitude points to Leaflet map markers and compute the great-circle distance between two of them in km.
My game's rigid body rotation keeps drifting off unit norm after many physics ticks — how do I renormalize the quaternion each frame?
